## CollectionReferenceVariant type

What a typed collection output position holds: a bound deferred collection of `T`<!-- -->, in either form.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type CollectionReferenceVariant<T, Id = unknown, R extends string = string> =
  | IdentityCollectionReference<T, Id, R>
  | SelectorCollectionReference<T, R>
```

**References:** [IdentityCollectionReference](./contracts.identitycollectionreference.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorCollectionReference](./contracts.selectorcollectionreference.md)

## Remarks

The collection counterpart of [ObjectReferenceVariant](./contracts.objectreferencevariant.md)<!-- -->. Broad consumers that only resolve can use [CollectionReference](./contracts.collectionreference.md) instead.
